Thanks for the detailed report and investigation. The reproduction steps
and explanation of how CSS zoom affects the overlay coordinates are very
helpful. I can also see the misalignment in the attached recording. We'll
keep this in mind alongside the work discussed in #36787 since the
highlighting systems may eventually be unified there.
